<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/prices/{price}/rate_change_preview"}
#docs
The period is the window of the customer's last finalized period invoice. `old_minor` rates that usage under the customer's current rate (the invoiced amount when the rate did not change in that period); `new_minor` under the draft. Fields you leave out keep their current values. Sorted by `diff_minor`, largest increase first, in pages of up to 200; at most 5,000 customers per request (`truncated` says when there are more). Writes nothing. Tax, discounts, credits and minimums are not applied.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `price` | `string` | **yes** | The usage price (`pro-monthly-usd`). |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | no | Meter prices: the default rate, minor units per `quantity_divisor` units. A decimal string with at most 12 decimal places and no exponent, for example `"0.25"`. |
| `quantity_divisor` | `string` | no | Meter prices: the number of units the rate is for, a whole number of 1 or more. |
| `tiers` | `array of object` | no | The tiers. Meter prices take `{up_to, unit_amount_decimal, flat_amount_minor}`; other usage prices take `{upToMinor, unitAmountMinor, flatAmountMinor}`, as on the price. |
| `rates` | `array of object` | no | Meter prices: the whole rate card. It replaces the current one. |
| `rates.match` | `object` | **yes** | The rate's match. |
| `rates.unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | no | The rate's unit amount decimal. |
| `rates.tiers` | `array of object` | no | The rate's tiers. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | no | Usage prices not on a meter: the unit amount in minor units. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Page size, 1–200 (default 200). |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Cursor: the last row's `customer` from the previous page. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `rate_change_preview`. One of `rate_change_preview`. |
| `price` | `string` | The price's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro-monthly-usd`). |
| `currency` | `string` | The rate change preview's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `basis` | `string` | The rate change preview's basis. One of `last_closed_period`. |
| `totals` | `object` | The rate change preview's totals. |
| `customers_without_usage` | `integer` | Customers on the price with no finalized period invoice yet. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | More than 5,000 customers are on the price. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.customer` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `data.customer_name` | `string` | The rate change preview's customer name. |
| `data.subscriptions` | `array of string` | The rate change preview's subscriptions. |
| `data.period_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | The start of the period the rate change preview covers (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | The rate change preview's period end. |
| `data.old_minor` | `integer` | The old in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `data.new_minor` | `integer` | The new in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `data.diff_minor` | `integer` | The diff in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `data.diff_bps` | `integer` | The change in basis points of `old_minor`; null when `old_minor` is 0. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The preview. |
| `400` | The price has no rate, or the draft is not a valid rate card. `param` names the field. |
| `404` | No such price. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/prices/pro-monthly-usd/rate_change_preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "amount_minor": 2900
  }'
```
